name: Fossify Notes
tagline: A simple text field for jotting down quick notes, no ads
description:
Fossify Notes is about as simple as a notes app gets: open it up and start typing. There are no ads, no accounts, and no clutter, just a clean space for jotting things down.

It's part of the Fossify family of privacy-friendly, open-source Android apps, built for people who want their tools to stay out of their way.
